content: Hanaaniyanne Saphphira
Issi Hanaaniya geetettiza asi Saphphira geetettiza ba machcheyra ba gade bayzides.
Machcheya Saphphiray lo7eththa erishin gadeza bayzida miishshaafe baggaa shaakki ashshidi baggaa ehidi Hawaareta kushen immides.

Qasse Phexroosi, «Haysso Hanaaniya! Neni Xillo Ayana bolla wordotanaassinne gadeza miishshaafe ashshana mala Xala7ey ays ne wozinan gelidee? Bayzanaappe kase gadezi neyssa gidennee? Ne bayzidaappe guye qasse miishshay ne kushen deennee? Histtiin ne hayssa mala wostta ne wozinan qoppadii? Neni Xoossa bolla wordotadasa attiin asa bolla gidenna» gides.
Hessa siyida mala Hanaaniyay kundi hayqqides; hessa siyida asay wuri daro babbides.
Attumasay dendidi ahaa xaaxidi heerakka efidi moogides.
Heedzdzu saateppe guye machcheya izi waanidaakko erontta dashe yadus.
Phexroosikka, «Ane taas yoota; intte gadeza bayzida waagay hanno xallaa?» gides. Izakka, «Ee hanno ha waagayn bayzidos» gadus.
Phexroosikka, «Intte Xoossa Ayana paaccanaas ays issi doona gididetii? Hekko ne azinaa moogida asati moogi simmidi karen penge bolla deettes. Istti nenakka kessi ekki efana» gides.
Iza siyida mala heerakka iza toho bolla kundada hayqqadus. Attumasaykka soo gelida mala hayqqidaaro be7idi kessi efidi izi azinaa achchan izo moogida.
Kumeththa Woosa Keeththa asaynne hessa siyida asay wuri daro babbides.
Hawaareta Kushen Paxida Daro Asaa
Hawaaretikka dere giddon daro malaatatanne malalisiza miish ooththida; ammanizayti wuri, «Solomoone simereteththaso» geetettiza pengen shiiqeettes.
Isttas babbida gishshas oonikka isttara walakettanaas koyibeenna; gido attiin derey istta keehi bonchchees.
Daro maccassatinne addeti wodeppe woden Godaan ammani ammani istta bolla gujettida.
Hessa gaason Phexroosi aadhdhishin haray attiin iza eeshoy harganchchatappe bagga harganchchata bolla wodhdhana mala hargizayti ichchiza alga bollanne hala bolla karen ishiseettes.
Yerusalaame yuushon diza katamatappe hargizaytanne tuna ayanay waayisizayta ehiin wuri paxida.
Hawaareta Bolla Gakkida Goodeteththinne Waaye
He wode qeeseta halaqaynne izara diza Saduqaaweta baggayti wurikka qanaate qanaatizayta xalla gidida.
Hawaareta oykkidi qasho keeththe gelththida.
Gido attiin Godaa kiitanchchay qammara qasho keeththaza kare doydi istta kessidi,
«Biidi Xoossa Keeththaa gibbe giddon eqqidi hayssa de7o qaalaa ubba deraas yootite» gides.

Gadey wontida mala isttas yootidayssa Xoossa Keeththaa gibbe gelidi dereza tamaarso oykkida; qeeseta halaqaynne izara dizayti yiidi Ayhudata duulataanne Isra7eele dere cimata kumeth issi bolla shiishshida; Hawaareta qasho keeththafe ekki yaana mala as yeddida.
Kiitetti bida asati biidi istta qasho keeththan demmibeettenna; simmidi,
«Qasho keeththay lo7i qulpeti dees; naagizaytikka penge bolla eqqi dishin nu be7idos; gido attiin nu doyi gelishin keeththan oonikka baa» gida.
Xoossa Keeth naagizayta halaqaynne qeeseta halaqatikka hessa siyida mala hanozan daro malalettidanne isttas hanoy wuri tikki gides.
Heerakka issi asi yiidi, «Hekko intte qasho keeththe gelththida asati Xoossa Keeththa gibbe giddon eqqidi dere tamaarson deettes» gides.
Xoossa Keeththe naagizayta halaqay ba oosanchchatara biidi istta oykki ekki yides; oykki ehidayti asay bana shuchchara caddontta mala babbidi wolqqaththontta loddara ehida.

Hawaareta ehidi Ayhudata duulata sinththan essida; qeeseta halaqaykka istta, «Hayssa ha sunththaan intte tamaarsontta mala inttes lo7eththi yootidoskoshin intte intte timirteza Yerusalaame ubbaan kunththeeta; qasse nunakka ha addeza suuththas oyshettizayta histtanaas gixxi dendideta» gides.
Phexroosinne hankko hawaaretikka zaaridi, «Nuni asappe aaththidi Xoossas azazettanaas bessees.
«Intte iza miththa bolla kaqqi wodhida Yesusa nu aawantta Xoossay iza hayqoppe denththides.
Izikka Isra7eele naytas nagarappe simmidi maarettana mala Xoossi iza ubbaafe bollanne ashshizaade histtidi ba ushachchan dhoqqu dhoqqu histtides.
Nunikka hayssas markkatta; qasseka Xoossi baas azazettiza oonaska immida Xillo Ayanaykka markka» gida.
Asati hessa siyidi iita hanqo hanqettida; wodhanakka koyida.
Gido attiin dere achchan keehi bonchchettida issi woga astamaare, izikka Gamalyaale geetettiza Farsaaweta baggay dere cimata giddon dendi eqqidi Hawaareti guuththa wode karen gam7ana mala azazides.
Dere cimatas, «Isra7eele asatoo! Intte hayta asata bolla ooththanayssa daro akeekara ooththanaas bessees.

Hayssafe kase issi Tewodaasa geetettizaadey bana gita as histti qoodi dendiin oyddu xeetu derey iza kaallides; gido attiin izi asa kushen hayqqides; iza kaallizaytikka coo laalettiin iza hanoy coo mela attides.
Izappe guyekka derey taybettiza wode Galila Yuhuday dendidi daro dere banara kaaleththides. Bana kaallizaytakka demmides; gido attiin izikka dhaydes; iza kaallizaytikka wuri dhayda.
«Hessa gishshas ta ha7i inttena gizay hayta asata aggite, bochchofte; istta qofay woykko istta oosoy asappe gidikko dhayana.
Xoossafe gidikko qasse intte istta teqqanaas dandayekketa; oonee erizay intte Xoossara ooyettishe beettanakko» gides.
Isttika iza zoreza ekkidi Hawaareta xeygidi garafissida; nam7anththo Yesusa sunththan haasayontta mala azazidi yeddida.
Hawaaretikka iza sunththa gishshas kawuyanaas bessiza gishshas daro ufayettishe dere cimata achchafe kezi bida.
Gallas gallas Xoossa Keeththaninne issaa issaa keeththan Yesusi izi Xoossi dooridaade gididayssa tamaarsofenne sabbakoppe mulekka guye gibeettenna.
